items.title: Samarawickrama's composed knock seals SL's semi-final berth
items.summary: Samarawickrama's unbeaten 48 and Praboda's career-best three wickets helped Sri Lanka survive Bangladesh scare

items.title: Harshitha sinks Tigresses as Sri Lanka seal semifinal spot
items.summary: Bangladesh staged a spirited fightback with the ball at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium, but Harshitha Samarawickrama's brilliant unbeaten 37-ball 48 carried Sri Lanka to a four-wicket win and into the Women’s Asia Cup semifinals.

items.title: Gunaratne in as SL bowl; Easmin debuts for Bangladesh
items.summary: Sri Lanka have dominated Bangladesh in the format with 13 wins from 16 matches

items.title: Batting in focus as Tigresses eye semifinal berth
items.summary: With net run rate the first tiebreaker, a victory for Bangladesh would confirm their place in the semifinals.

items.title: Hasan Mahmud takes seven as Kent beat Worcestershire
items.summary: Hasan Mahmud made an impressive return to the County Championship, taking seven wickets across two innings as Kent secured their sixth victory of the season.

items.title: Higher match fees, but playing chances remain key
items.summary: Tamim said a player completing the domestic season could earn Tk 35-40 lakh, including salary -- more than Tk 3 lakh a month when averaged over a year. But that raises a pertinent question: will all domestic cricketers have a realistic opportunity to earn that amount, or will the increase primarily benefit those who already feature regularly in the national team, ‘A’ team and top-tier domestic competitions?

items.title: 'Top, top bowler': Kent's Milnes full of praise for Hasan Mahmud
items.summary: Kent seamer Matt Milnes was full of praise for his bowling partner Hasan Mahmud after the Bangladesh pacer continued his merry run of form on his return to county cricket.

items.title: UAE keep semi-final hopes alive after convincing win over Indonesia

items.title: Shanto, Mahmud back in Bangladesh T20I squad for Asian Games
items.summary: Litton Das too returns as the T20I captain after missing the Zimbabwe and Australia series due to a hamstring injury
